name: Repository Hub
tagline: Find every HelloWorld project, read about it, try its demo and browse its code
summary: The page you are on. It reads the HelloWorldIE GitHub account at run time and shows each project from its hub card: pictures, guides, demo, README and code. Signed out it shows public projects; a read-only token adds the private ones.
features: Browse projects by category, kind, status and language
Open a project's demo in a sealed frame
Read the README and browse the code
See every project on a 3D planet
Check which repos still need a hub card
no_demo: The hub is itself live at its own address.

gallery.caption: The single-screen dashboard with demo data, in light mode
